description.value: Voyage Liquor Express (branded 'Ganges Express' on the company website) is one of five locations in the locally owned Voyage Liquor chain serving Vancouver Island and Salt Spring Island since 2006. Situated on Lower Ganges Road in the main commercial hub of Salt Spring Island, it offers a curated selection of local, national, and global beer, wine, and spirits. Cyclists passing through Ganges can stock up on cold drinks, with same-day delivery and a loyalty rewards program also available.
